title: 편의점에서 교통카드 충전하기: 만 원 할게요
objective: You can ask to top up a card and say the amount and how you will pay using -을게요/-ㄹ게요.
summary: A short conversation for topping up a transit card at a convenience store.
setting: At a convenience store counter. A customer wants to top up a transit card before taking the bus.

task.title: Top up your card
task.line: Use the dialogue and word list to choose, fill in, or answer in Korean.

words.exampleMeaning: I left my transit card at home.

words.meaning: to top up, to add money to a card
words.exampleMeaning: Can I top up at the subway station too?
I don't have any cash right now.
Please put your bag on the chair.

words.meaning: to take off, to remove (from a surface)
words.exampleMeaning: Take the card off when it beeps.
How much balance is left on the card?

dialogue.meaning: Excuse me, can I top up a transit card here?
Yes, you can. How much would you like to add?

dialogue.korean: 만 원 할게요. 카드로 내도 돼요?
dialogue.meaning: I'll do 10,000 won. Can I pay by card?

dialogue.korean: 아, 그럼 현금으로 낼게요. 여기 있어요.
dialogue.meaning: Oh, then I'll pay in cash. Here you go.

dialogue.korean: 교통카드를 여기 위에 올려 주세요. 다 될 때까지 떼지 마세요.
dialogue.meaning: Please put your transit card on here. Don't take it off until it's done.
Okay, I won't take it off.

dialogue.korean: 다 됐습니다. 잔액은 만 이천 원이에요. 영수증 드릴까요?
dialogue.meaning: All done. Your balance is 12,000 won. Would you like a receipt?

exercises: Fill in the blank with -을게요/-ㄹ게요: ① 직원: 충전 중이니까 잠깐만요. 손님: 네, ____. (기다리다) ② 직원: 카드는 기계 위에 놓아 주세요. 손님: 네, 지금 ____. (올리다)
Read the dialogue. Write O (true) or X (false): ① 이 편의점에서는 충전할 때 카드로 낼 수 있어요. ② 손님은 현금으로 냈어요.
Read the dialogue and answer in Korean: 충전한 뒤에 카드 잔액은 얼마예요?
Answer the clerk in Korean using -을게요/-ㄹ게요. You want to top up 20,000 won: 직원: 얼마 충전해 드릴까요?
